intro.text: Ah. There you are. Welcome, welcome, to the curious and rather wonderful world of Bamzooki.
Here, you shall be part inventor, part coach, and part proud parent to creatures of your very own design.

title.text: Back again? Splendid. The arena awaits.
Ah, the home of champions. Where shall we wander today?

build.text: Now then. Let us build ourselves a creature.
To the workshop! Twiddle, tweak, and tinker to your heart's content.
A blank canvas, and a head full of mischief. Perfect.

coach_power.text: Power, dear friend, is how hard those little legs will push. Be bold.

coach_legs.text: More legs means more grip — though rather more to carry about, of course.

coach_stride.text: Stride sets the sweep of each step. Long and loping, or quick and busy. The choice is yours.

save.text: Saved, and immortalised. A fine addition to your menagerie.
There. Catalogued for posterity. Do try not to lose it.

race_start.text: And they're off! Do try to contain your excitement.
Here we go, then. May the most peculiar creature win.
The race is underway. Hold on to something.

lead_change.text: Aha! A change at the very front!
Would you look at that — a new leader emerges!
The lead changes hands. The plot, as they say, thickens.

collision.text: Oof. That was a proper coming-together.
Crunch! Well, that's gratitude for you.

win.text: Magnificent! A triumph of design and sheer audacity.
Victory! I do hope you're suitably pleased with yourself.
First across the line. Bravo. Truly, bravo.

lose.text: Ah. Well. Not every masterpiece is appreciated in its own time.
So very nearly. Back to the workshop, I think.
A noble effort, undone by physics. It happens to the best of us.

new_record.text: A new personal best! Someone's been practising.
Record broken! I'm almost lost for words. Almost.

champion.text: Champion of all Bamzooki! Take a bow, you magnificent creature.
The trophy is yours. History will remember this peculiar little beast.
